message: I remember the time we had a surprise blackout during a summer storm. I had just finished telling my family how I always keep extra flashlights and power banks ready, and wouldn’t you know it? The moment the lights flickered and went out, I felt a little smug as I whipped out my trusty lantern and charged our phones. It turned into a cozy family game night by lantern light, proving once again that a little preparedness can turn an inconvenience into a fun memory. What’s your go-to trick for staying comfortable when the power goes out? 😊
